summary: Initiated Phase P5: Multi-Scene Quality-Aware Mosaic & Temporal Change Detection
details: Created PLAN-0006. Implementing atyaf_core/mosaic (QualityMosaicEngine with union extent, quality-aware pixel blending, and Source_Scene_ID provenance raster), atyaf_core/temporal (ChangeDetectionEngine with dNDVI, dNBR burn severity classification, dLST), and adding Tool 06 to arcgis_pro/ATIAF.pyt.
